# Sitepresso

> Sitepresso is a website builder SaaS for small businesses to create marketing websites,
> booking websites and e-commerce websites — no code required.

## Verticals

- Marketing website builder — professional brand sites (home, about, services, contact, local SEO)
- Booking website builder — online appointments, service menus, staff profiles, reminders
- E-commerce website builder — product catalogue, cart, checkout, payments, delivery/pickup

## Important pages

- https://sitepresso.com/ — overview, themes, pricing
- https://sitepresso.com/blog — guides and comparisons

## Key facts

- Audience: small and local businesses, professionals, clinics, salons, restaurants, retail, trades, consultants.
- Features: industry themes, layouts, color systems, custom domains, SEO settings, AI-assisted content, online booking, online store, payments, multi-language.
- No coding required; sites can go live in minutes.

## Topics

- small business website builder
- booking website builder
- e-commerce website builder
- salon, dental, law firm, restaurant, fitness and other industry websites
- no-code website creation
